fact: The report states DHIS-2 is Nigeria's nationwide facility-based reporting system and the primary platform for routine aggregate data, while noting that at the start of the administration in 2023 only about 15% of facilities shared data electronically with DHIS-2 and most efforts remain paper-based and fragmented.
title: State of Health of the Nation Report 2024
publisher: Federal Ministry of Health & Social Welfare, Nigeria
